reply.text:
Wanting to push harder is a good instinct, and the way to do it is by adding load or reps in small steps, not by grinding every set to the wall. Most people do well adding a little weight or a rep or two once the top of their rep range feels clean, and keeping a rep or two in reserve on most sets so they can come back and do it again.

If you tell me which lift or which part of your week you want to push, I can look at what you've logged and tell you where there's room.
